material_groups.Non_Metallic_Conductors: Carbon/Graphite is the only solid non-metal conductor.
material_groups.Electrolytes: Conducting liquids like salt solution and acids.
material_groups.Insulators: Rubber, plastic, dry wood, glass, and pure (distilled) water.
material_groups.visual_reference: [IMAGE_015: Sorting bin of conductors vs. insulators]

hazards.Short_Circuit: A shortcut of low resistance causing high heat. Often caused by bare wires touching.
hazards.visual_reference: [IMAGE_016: Two bare wires sparking where they touch]
hazards.Overloading: Connecting too many appliances to one socket.
hazards.Wet_Hands: Water reduces skin resistance, making a shock more likely and fatal.

safety_devices.The_Fuse: A tin-lead alloy wire with a low melting point. It melts to break the path during a surge.
safety_devices.Earthing: Connecting an appliance's metal case to a wire that leads to the ground to prevent shock.
